title: Incident Context Synthesis Gateway: synthesize traces, metrics and logs into runbook suggestions & postmortem drafts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Operators receive PagerDuty pages and Slack threads with fragmented signals (traces in APM, metrics spikes, noisy logs). Triage is slow because on-call must assemble context from multiple UIs, copy/paste into runbooks, and author a postmortem skeleton. Goal: build a lightweight gateway that listens to incident webhook events (PD + Slack), gathers trace spans, metric slices, and representative log snippets, synthesizes a compact evidence bundle, and returns: 1) a ranked list of relevant runbook steps (with similarity scores and provenance links), 2) a prefilled postmortem draft (timeline + suspected root causes + suggested mitigations), and 3) an attached evidence bundle (trace links + filtered log excerpts + metric charts). The output must be editable by the on-call in the incident Slack thread and attach cleanly to the PD incident.
background: We already surface trace snippets and runbook links in a few experiments (see ENG-41204 and ENG-28911) but they are piecemeal: separate components produce trace attachments or static runbook links. This ticket unifies those efforts into a pluggable service (synthesis-gateway) that does evidence extraction, on-the-fly runbook ranking (semantic similarity against our runbook corpus), PII redaction, and postmortem bootstrapping. The aim is to reduce mean time-to-detect/mean time-to-resolve by removing manual context assembly and accelerating runbook selection.
design_notes: Key design decisions so far: 1) Pull only the top-N traces and metric slices that cross SLO thresholds (configurable sampling) to avoid noise. 2) Use a two-step ranking: lexically filter by tags/alerts, then run a lightweight embedding similarity against cached runbook embeddings (update nightly). 3) Provide a confidence band and provenance (which span/metric produced the match). 4) Redact secrets/PII via an extensible redaction pipeline (regex + ML classifier). 5) Expose a Slack modal for the on-call to accept/edit suggestions before attaching to PD. 6) Keep the gateway stateless; evidence bundles live in a short-lived storage bucket with signed links. 7) Telemetry: every synthesized output must emit trace_id, bundle_id, match_score, and whether the on-call accepted/modified suggestions.
implementation_plan: M1 - infra + API (1 week): service skeleton, PD & Slack webhook handlers, bucket for evidence bundles. M2 - extraction adapters (2 weeks): trace query worker, metrics slice extractor, log sampler with sampling heuristics. M3 - runbook ranking (1 week): embedding index, similarity API, provenance mapping. M4 - postmortem generator (1 week): timeline assembly, templated markdown output. M5 - UI + Slack modal (1 week): draft preview and accept/modify buttons, attach to PD via PD API. M6 - e2e tests + canary (1 week). We will parallelize adapters and ranking work across two engineers.
updates: 2026-02-18 - Kickoff: scoped MVP with PM and SRE. Added Aisha (creator) and Miguel (owner). Agreed success metric: reduce initial triage time by >=25% on sampled PD incidents.
2026-02-22 - Prototype: PoC service created that accepts PD webhooks and returns a stubbed draft postmortem. PoC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1958 (prototype).
2026-02-28 - Design review with SRE and Product: accepted semantic-runbook ranking approach; flagged redaction requirements for regulated customers. Action: add opt-out flag for private deployments.
2026-03-04 - Infra work started: storage bucket + signed links, RBAC to ensure evidence bundles expire after 7 days by default. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1962.
2026-03-09 - Integration tests: trace adapter can fetch span families for a 99th percentile latency incident in staging. Found high cardinality span noise; added prefix-based sampling rule.
2026-03-11 - Security sync: infosec requested explicit proof of redaction for all text outputs when customer data label != none. Implementing redaction audit log and toggle for private installs.

2026-03-13 - Current: runbook ranking MVP implemented, nightly embedding refresh job scheduled. Slack modal UX prototype screens uploaded to Confluence (link in attachments). Ready for initial canary on low-risk PD services.
acceptance_criteria: On PD incident creation (canary scope) the gateway attaches a single evidence bundle with: 1 trace link, 1 metric chart PNG, and up to 3 log excerpts (redacted).
Runbook ranking returns top-3 candidate runbooks with similarity scores and source links; median of runbook matches for sampled incidents must have score >= 0.45 in the embedding metric.
A draft postmortem (markdown) is produced and can be edited in Slack modal and attached to PD; draft must include event timeline + suspected root cause (automatically populated).
PII redaction must pass the redaction unit tests; no direct customer identifiers (email, full phone, api keys) present in exported bundle samples.
Telemetry: every synthesized output emits bundle_id, match_score, oncall_action (accepted/edited/ignored) and is visible in the Console under the incident timeline for 90 days.
Canary rollout to 10 PD services with no more than 5% false-positive runbook matches (tracked over a 2 week window).
test_plan: Unit tests for extraction adapters, e2e harness that simulates PD -> Slack flow, redaction fuzz tests using synthetic PII corpus, and load test to ensure gateway processes <= 20 webhooks/s with median p95 < 300ms for match ranking. Add canary metric dashboards: match_accuracy, average_triage_time, bundle_size_bytes.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal canary: enable for non-customer internal services (2 days). 2) Extended canary: enable for 10 low-risk PD services (2 weeks), collect match acceptance telemetry. 3) Gradual customer rollout: opt-in per customer (enterprise/beta). 4) Full GA when acceptance >= 75% for internal incidents and security review complete.
runbook_template:
# Incident draft
## Summary
- Time window: {{start}} - {{end}}
- Services impacted: {{services}}

## Timeline (auto)
- {{t0}}: Alert fired (metric: {{metric}})
- {{t1}}: Spike in latency (trace: {{trace_link}})

## Suspected cause (auto)
- {{root_cause_guess}} (confidence: {{score}})

## Immediate mitigation (suggested)
- 1) Rollback deploy on service X
- 2) Route traffic away from region Y

## Follow-ups / action items
- [ ] Add circuit-breaker to client library
- [ ] Add regression test for slow path

(Editable before attach)
redaction_policy: Default: regex filters for emails, API keys, credit card-like patterns; ML-based PII tagger for names/SSNs; opt-out flag for private deployments. Redaction audit captures original snippet_id -> redacted_text hash.
notes: Follow-up: coordinate with Legal for retention policy across regions. Also validate behavior for Dedicated/Private deployments where runbook corpus is customer-managed — plan for local embedding index option.
